audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and First item sat on 'Skill' in both layers while the prose (whys[3], whys[5], mid) already said those stages are clearly yours, and 2+ items was credited to Vladimir even though Silver Bolts' max-health true damage is exactly what beats a Crimson Pact health pool.
audit.why: The already-applied mirror set rows 3 and 5 to Vladimir and row 6 to Vayne; matching it keeps both pages telling one story.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 5 to Vladimir (8/10), row 6 to Vayne (4/10), with phases[6].why and whys[6] rewritten to the real reason that stage flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text told the late-game as 'your burst deletes her before she ramps', which contradicts the 9.5/10 carry threat printed on the same page.
audit.why: Final Hour (100/85/70s) grants AD, invisibility during Tumble and a reduced Tumble cooldown; Silver Bolts is percent-max-health true damage on every third hit, so stacked health helps her, not you.
audit.corrected: Late spike rewritten around Silver Bolts and the Final Hour invisibility.

audit.whatIsWrong: The do's and don'ts bodies were copies of the trading blurb and carried no cooldowns, no ranges, and no mention that her burst opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Tumble 300 range / 6-2s, auto reset; W Silver Bolts third-hit percent-max-health true damage; E Condemn 550 range / 20-12s, knockback that stuns on terrain; R 100/85/70s. Vladimir Q and E both reach 600.
audit.corrected: Condemn's 20s and its terrain condition, the 600-vs-300 range gap, the Tumble reset tell, and the true-damage rule now sit in dosFull and dontsFull.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Vayne carry threat 9.5/10: Silver Bolts true damage scales past the health you stack, so close the game before she reaches it.

edits.before: In a lane trade your scaling burst beats her before Final Hour ramps.
edits.after: Silver Bolts true damage cuts straight through the health Crimson Pact stacks.

edits.before: Watch her R Final Hour invisibility and true damage in skirmishes, but in a straight top-lane trade your burst deletes her before she ramps.
edits.after: Her W Silver Bolts true damage ignores the health you stack, and Final Hour hides her Tumble — burst her from range or take the fight to your team.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — fight in open ground, not beside a wall.

edits.before: Transfusion Vayne on cooldown, E-charge behind the wave, and pool the one ability his kill plan needs.
edits.after: Transfusion and Tides of Blood both reach 600; her Tumble is 300 — poke as she steps up and walk out.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Tumble is an auto reset — pool on the wind-up, not the cast.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Condemn knocks you back; into terrain it stuns — never trade with a wall behind you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' third hit is true damage — your health pool is no wall.

notes: Row 6 now reads Vayne on both pages, matching the mirror and the 9.5/10 carry threat. Whether an in-flight Condemn still lands on a Vladimir who pools mid-travel is not in Riot's text — left unstated, same as the mirror.
